title: Surreal Pyramid Conjuration
description: A blue-skinned horned female figure in a green dress stands atop a soldier's shoulders on rocky terrain, channeling purple lightning from a glowing orb toward a giant orange pyramid. The desert landscape features a massive cracked skull emerging from the sand by the turquoise sea, while a swirling vortex of faces, symbols, and eyes dominates the sky above.
prompt: Surreal desert scene with a blue-skinned horned sorceress in flowing green and purple robes standing on the shoulders of a soldier in green camouflage. She holds a glowing orb emitting purple lightning toward a massive orange pyramid. A giant cracked white skull with flowers on its head emerges from orange sand dunes beside a turquoise ocean. The sky is filled with a swirling vortex of colorful faces, eyes, and mystical symbols. Dramatic fantasy illustration style.
